verdict: Ads are running and converting; your lead intake pipeline needs immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, Google Ads recorded 15 conversions and your Google Business Profile drove 116 local actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — so the advertising itself is working. However, your CRM is showing zero leads for the same period, which means incoming contacts are not being captured or recorded correctly; this is a pipeline gap, not an ad performance problem. We've identified that lead intake has been unattended since early July, and closing that gap is the immediate priority before the September heating-season ramp. Your booking automation readiness is also being confirmed this week. Once intake is restored and the LSA heating campaigns go live September 1, you should expect lead volume to reflect what the ads are already generating.

highlights.phrase: Google Ads conversions recorded in the last 28 days
local actions on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, directions, and site visits
average daily ad spend over the last 7 days, with a deliberate throttle in place ahead of the fall ramp

watch_item.issue: Incoming leads are not being logged in your CRM — 15 ad conversions and 39 profile calls have no matching records, pointing to an open intake seat since early July.
watch_item.fix: Intake ownership is being confirmed by August 31, which unblocks proper lead capture and clears the path for the scale-up planned alongside the September heating campaigns.
